dataLocations: Credentials: OS keychain via Obsidian SecretStorage, referenced by keychainId / mcp:<server>:<field> refs.
Chats: agent-chat-index.json plus the durable JSONL session store in the plugin data folder; optional chat notes carry mode: agent frontmatter.
Migration backups: private migration folder written before rewriting settings, with credential fields excluded.
Store size policy: warn at 16 MiB, stop new runs at 32 MiB; reads, cancel, export, and pending approvals stay available.
trustAndLimits: MCP servers and their tool output are third-party and untrusted; annotations do not grant read-only rights, unknown effects require per-call approval and are rejected in plan mode.
Shell/stdio MCP are optional host capabilities; the plugin never installs them and does not provide an OS sandbox. Opaque local processes are disabled in strict mode.
Approval recovery completes a missing receipt only when the effect already happened, never replays unknown/unsafe effects, and does not claim exactly-once external side effects.
Background subagent reports are delivered once; a cancelled root stores without waking the parent; closing Obsidian stops background work and reopening only restores state.
Legacy chats are read-only history or clearly marked text material, not a reconstructed full tool history; original data is not deleted.
No telemetry, hosted service, account system, auto-update CLI, or runtime download; the only network peers are configured providers, configured MCP servers, and explicitly fetched URLs.
notRun: Real Obsidian application runs (launch, vault open, visual review, Keychain, quit/restart).
Real provider model turns and real HTTP/stdio MCP connections.
Windows and Linux hosts (drive/junction/UNC/ADS, symlinked volumes).
External publication: no GitHub release, community-plugin submission, or upload of any user data was performed by this task.
notAdvertised: No three-platform support claim while win32/linux are not_run.
